The Woman Behind the Brand Kia Owner & Stylist
Meet Kia

Beauty is personal—and every client deserves to feel seen.

I created Beauty by Kia to give clients more than a hairstyle. I want every appointment to feel comfortable, thoughtful, and centered around the look that helps you feel most confident.

I believe great beauty service starts with listening. That means understanding your vision, being honest about what will work for your hair, setting clear expectations, and giving each style the time and care it deserves.

My Beauty Philosophy

Every style is a collaboration.

You bring the vision. I bring the care, creativity, and attention to detail. Together, we create a look that complements your personality and helps you walk away feeling renewed.
